# littletabi — AI-assisted, regularly updated family-travel guides for Japan

> Honest, practical guides for families visiting Japan with kids.
> Written with AI and edited for clarity. Each guide shows a last-updated date.
> Prices and opening hours change — we ask readers to confirm on official sites.

## Principles
- We do not fake first-hand experience. We are upfront that guides are AI-assisted.
- Topics: transport, food & allergies, baby gear, itineraries, hotels, eSIM.
